buildPaths.label: Rod of Ages · Battle-mage + Tear
buildPaths.description: Rush Rod of Ages after Tear → Archangel's Staff → Rabadon's Deathcap. Adds health so you can stay in extended fights.

buildPaths.label: Luden's Echo · Burst mage
buildPaths.description: Rush Luden's Echo → Stormsurge → Rabadon's Deathcap. All-in damage; squishier but kills faster.

buildPaths.label: Archangel's Staff · Scaling mage
buildPaths.description: Rush Archangel's Staff after Tear → Rabadon's Deathcap. Tear stacks mana for late-game power; weaker early.

buildPaths.label: Hextech Rocketbelt · Battle-mage + Tear
buildPaths.description: Rush Hextech Rocketbelt after Tear → Archangel's Staff → Rabadon's Deathcap. Adds health so you can stay in extended fights.
